title: The Silent Gate
synopsis: Kit tests the new PR hook in every agent, finds Antigravity silently ignoring it because of another tool's broken block, and makes Tracetoon say so out loud.
altText: Panel 1: Kit tests the hook in each agent; Claude's gate works. Panel 2: Kit wonders why Antigravity let a PR command through. Panel 3: Glitch hides in another tool's broken config block, which makes Antigravity ignore the whole file. Panel 4: Kit adds a warning that names the broken block, and Sam is pleased the problem is now visible.

panels.scene: Kit tests the PR hook in each agent

panels.scene: Kit stares at a PR command that got through in Antigravity

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: Codex is waiting for trust. Antigravity says nothing at all.
